proposal_source: Parent description before freeze; this is a conditional contract review, not approval of implementation.
permitted_scope: An entirely unvocalized context label may name a fully compatible target whose gemination and inflection are independently supported by the exact acquired noun reading. The context is identity evidence only.
conditions: The declared label must be entirely unvocalized, not partly vocalized or explicitly contradictory.
The independent learned reading must belong to the exact target occurrence and preserve its complete source segmentation.
The lexical witness must establish the claimed form and nominal status without importing facts from context or expected outputs.
Every homonymous compatible context identity remains a candidate; receipt existence does not grant unique selection.
No generic form matcher is loosened for verbs, prefixes, carriers, dagger alif, or unattested source shapes as a side effect.
The independent verifier must rederive raw source support under the same exclusion profile; a caller-supplied receipt, lexical ID, manifest or hash is not authority.
Existing visibly contradictory names, source identities, context scopes and role-case guards must still fail.
remaining_review: Inspect the later implementation only after material freeze, including negative conditions and both independent validators. No code approval is granted by this document.
